title: Comparison refuses to insert or delete a paragraph holding a simple field
symptom: compare refuses with "cannot track a whole paragraph's simple field outside a field it replaces", so a heading added under a table of contents made by insert_toc cannot be compared
workaround: add or remove the paragraph by hand on the redline

title: Comparison refuses two versions where a footnote reference moved
symptom: compare refuses and writes nothing ("its reference moved to another site")

title: Comparison refuses a paragraph moved after a final table, or added or deleted after a moved or redlined final table
symptom: compare refuses with "needs an adjacent paragraph for a final paragraph move" or "... for a final paragraph change" (after a table moved to the end), or "holds an existing tracked revision" (after a table that holds tracked changes)
workaround: put a paragraph after the table in both versions, or resolve the earlier tracked changes on both copies first

title: Text replacement through Python is slower than the CLI
symptom: about 1.5 times the time of the CLI for the same pairs
workaround: when only replacing, use `oxoffice docx replace FILE --map pairs.json`

title: Edits cost more as the document grows, most on files saved by Word or Google Docs
symptom: Run.text, Paragraph.text, add_run, Table.add_row, remove_content and notes cost the whole body: tens of milliseconds per call, up to seconds on long reports
workaround: batch the edits, or build the content aside and insert it once

title: Form operations cost seconds on long documents
symptom: about 0.1 s at 25 paragraphs, 3 to 9 s at 1,000
workaround: pass every rule in one call

title: Non-breaking hyphens and positional tabs are missing from paragraph text
symptom: Paragraph text and text search skip w:noBreakHyphen and w:ptab, so "co-op" written with a non-breaking hyphen reads "coop", a search for "co-op" finds nothing, and replacing "coop" leaves the hyphen after the replacement
workaround: search for the text on each side of the hyphen or positional tab

title: Word files saved in another language: headings and tables of contents find no heading
symptom: insert_toc lists nothing, and the Rust headings() and document_outline() are empty, when Word wrote localised style ids such as Titre1
workaround: call rebuild_toc() after insert_toc(); find headings through the styles named "heading N"

title: Document header and footer calls ignore the headers a section inherits
symptom: the Rust header_text() and footer_text() return None when the last section inherits its header, and set_header() changes the last section only
workaround: read and edit each section's header: Rust section_story(section, kind, variant), Python document.section(i).header

title: Removing a paragraph leaves its notes behind, and removing a note leaves its custom mark
symptom: remove_content keeps the paragraph's footnotes and endnotes as unreferenced notes; removing a note made with a custom mark (Rust create_footnote_with_mark) keeps the mark
workaround: remove the paragraph's notes first (remove_footnote, remove_endnote, same names in Python); delete a leftover mark with replace_text

title: A list item numbered through its style cannot be restarted
symptom: restart_numbering fails with "paragraph has no explicit numbering level" on the List Number paragraphs of Word and python-docx files, whose numbering comes from the style
workaround: Rust: give the paragraph its own numbering first (set_numbering with the num_id and level of effective_paragraph_properties), then restart; Python: start a new list (add_numbering_definition, add_numbering_instance, Paragraph.numbering)

title: A presentation part with a control character is refused at open
symptom: open fails with "PackageError ... holds U+0001" and `oxoffice pptx validate` exits 1, while PowerPoint opens the file
workaround: remove the character from that part's bytes, then open the file
